page.overview:
Who is Marasale Jureen?

Marasale's name could indicate a Domani origin (see Duhara Basaheen, Saroiya Farseen, Sanaiye Asaheen, and Hafeen Bakuvun).

She was the Amyrlin Seat at the time of Cadsuane Melaidhrin and Romanda Cassin's births.

Marasale held the position for twenty-seven years until her death in . She was Cemaile Sorenthaine's successor and Feragaine Saralman's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

She was in large part a puppet of the Hall, chosen because the Sitters thought she would be easily controlled by them. In fact, in large part it happened.
